scope: Read source and existing evidence only. No tests/ROS/WSL/ELF/GL/build execution.

compile_chain: generated/main.cpp Runner loads AUTOAIM_CONFIG and passes cfg[detector]
ShenZhen::compile passes resulting infer_device to Core::compile_model
cpu_scope.qualification: Static verified config/source chain for old live and diagnostic builds. Runtime thread count/execution property dump was not recorded; AUTO default alone does not establish live AUTO.

guard_review: Exact PreparedNativeBGR type and WeakKeyRegistry membership required; object.__new__ alone creates no registered proof.
Same immutable bytes OBJECT is required, not only equal content.
Original image scalar tuple, frame schema/episode/frame/exposure/capture/control/deadline and intrinsics/distortion and original four capture state vectors have exact type/value matching.
Pipe snapshots top scalars then deepcopies frame before validation and receipt matching.
Mismatched present token rejects without fallback. Missing token retains synchronous full host hash.
Sender original 80ms deadline remains checked at prepare/serialize/receive; Linux complete BGR SHA remains unchanged.
Only header explicit control/time/frame/FOV goes on the wire, no receipt/private bytes serialization.
limits: Receipt is a trusted-service accidental byte/metadata pairing guard, not an authorization capability.
Robot/consumer/binding_epoch are validated at native ingress/context and constrained by unique owned binding output path; they are not explicitly retained in this receipt record.

Derived pitchlink quaternion/angular vectors/camera mount and own_team/referee fields are not matched to receipt. Native pipeline derives/fixes them upstream, and hash-reuse does not introduce trust over those fields. Do not call this receipt a seal of every sensor field.
Token reuse alone is not prevented; original native duplicate exposure gates and adapter last_capture provide replay rejection.
suggested_nonblocking_regressions: Deleting proof retains legacy host SHA call and catches changed bytes.
Different generation/consumer with same image frame ID is rejected by ingress/unique binding path; receipt is not the asserted authority.
Changed derived optical/quaternion field: explicitly document whether allowed because non-receipt scope or add full frame guard if a future complete source seal is claimed.
Dropping the only token reference releases its WeakKeyRegistry record; no retained per-frame bytes accumulate.
recent_run_scope: Latest logical13 attempt2 failed before supervisor first marker: zero physics/raw/requests. It cannot localize NN compute and is not an optimization result.
